name: Makkuro's Guide to RouteVN
source:
You wake up in a strange place in a dream-like state and encounter a mysterious girl.
The girl says she will guide you on your journey to 'Bring Your Visual Novel to Life'.
Are you ready for this journey?

[from [url=https://routevn.itch.io/makkuros-guide-to-routevn]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你在恍若梦境的迷离状态下于一处陌生之地醒来，邂逅了一名神秘少女。
少女表示，她将在“让你的视觉小说化为现实”的旅途中为你引路。
你准备好踏上这段旅程了吗？

[摘自[url=https://routevn.itch.io/makkuros-guide-to-routevn]itch.io[/url]]
